query: Draw a labeled diagram of the human digestive system

clip_prompt: scientific cross-section diagram, human digestive system, mouth, esophagus, stomach, small intestine, pancreas, large intestine, anus, digestive organs, educational illustration, detailed anatomical, white background, biology textbook style, clean linework, no labels, no text
t5_prompt: A comprehensive cross-sectional anatomical diagram showing the complete human digestive system from the oral cavity through to the anal opening, rendered in scientific educational style on a white background. The mouth appears at the top with the tongue and salivary glands, flowing downward through the pharynx into the esophagus, a muscular tube that descends through the thorax and connects to the stomach positioned in the upper left abdomen. The stomach's curved walls are depicted with its three layers showing the mucosa, submucosa, and muscular layers. Below the stomach extends the small intestine with its characteristic coiled loops of the duodenum, jejunum, and ileum, displaying the internal villi and microvilli structures that absorb nutrients. The pancreas is shown positioned behind the stomach's lower edge, with its ducts clearly illustrated carrying digestive enzymes into the duodenum. The large intestine frames the small intestine's perimeter, showing the colon's segments and terminal portion leading to the rectum and anus. Cross-sectional views reveal the layered architecture of the intestinal walls with epithelium, lamina propria, muscularis, and serosa. The liver and gallbladder are positioned superiorly with bile ducts connecting to the duodenum. Blood vessels branch throughout showing nutrient transport pathways. The entire system is rendered with anatomically accurate proportions and spatial relationships, detailed medical illustration style, scientific textbook accuracy, no labels, no text.
